name: Tibirita (Colombia)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and green, the blue hoist stripe charged with a ring of white stars around a six-pointed star beneath the light blue, yellow and red stripes of Cundinamarca.
history: Municipal flag of Tibirita, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: ring of stars around a six-pointed star
Cundinamarca department stripes at the top of the hoist stripe
